task: Modify a Unity game's assets to reduce unnecessary visual effects and improve performance/stutter on a Ryzen 5 5500U iGPU.

game.scripting_backend: IL2CPP (inferred from GameAssembly.dll / log call stacks)

important_stutter_event.interpretation: At least one major ~1 second stutter is asset cleanup/management, not purely GPU effects.

other_warnings: Repeated: Look rotation viewing vector is zero
Repeated SceneGuard PauseAllAnimators/ResumePausedAnimators, sometimes involving 100+ animators

files_examined_or_available.GameValue.json: Contains gameplay/global constants, not useful graphics configuration
files_examined_or_available.TKEditor_documentation: Official data/content modding editor; no clear global graphics controls
files_examined_or_available.development_tools_pdf: Shows official development/mod workflow but no clear global graphics settings

asset_findings.important_note: Presence of a shader/type does NOT prove that effect is active. Locate active profiles/components and edit their serialized settings/references rather than deleting shaders.

optional_second_pass.TemporalAA: disable; prefer FXAA or no AA
optional_second_pass.ShadowDistance: reduce to roughly 25-40 if a global setting is found

modification_strategy.preferred_tool: UABEA (Unity Asset Bundle Extractor Advanced) or another serializer that correctly supports Unity 2021.3 assets.
modification_strategy.current_state: User can find PostProcessProfile in UABEA.
instructions_for_local_agent: Inspect resources.assets and relevant sharedassets*.assets using a proper Unity serializer.
Find actual PostProcessProfile instances and follow m_Settings PPtr references (m_FileID/m_PathID) to effect-setting MonoBehaviours.
Determine effect type from MonoScript/type tree rather than guessing from PathID.
Disable expensive effect settings/components using their serialized enabled/active fields.
Do not blindly set every MonoBehaviour m_Enabled to 0.
Do not delete/blank shader assets merely because their names match an effect.
Preserve object table structure, alignment, dependencies, and external references.
Write a new modified assets file rather than overwriting the only original.
Prefer a first test disabling SSR, AO, Motion Blur, DOF, Chromatic Aberration and volumetrics; optionally Bloom afterward.
Report exact PathIDs/types/fields changed so modifications are reproducible/reversible.

performance_goal.primary: Reduce GPU load and frame-time spikes on Ryzen 5 5500U integrated graphics.
performance_goal.secondary: Reduce visual effects that are unnecessary to gameplay.
performance_goal.caveat: Asset cleanup stutter (~1033 ms event) is a separate issue and may remain even after reducing post-processing.

request_to_local_agent: Analyze the local Unity asset files directly and make a safe low-effects variant. Use UABEA/UnityPy or equivalent tooling available locally. Identify actual active PostProcessProfile and effect-setting objects, then disable the expensive effects listed above. Do not guess byte offsets or destroy shaders. Keep backups and produce a detailed change log with file, PathID, type, field, old value, new value.
